title: configure-module input
description: Enable or disable the insights collector

enabled.description: Run the collector. Requires a cluster subscription and no other enabled insights instance in the cluster.

base_url.description: Root URL of the insights server, with no path. If omitted, the current value is kept (initially https://insights.nethesis.it)

verify_tls.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the insights server. If omitted, the current value is kept (initially true)

log_level.description: Lowest level of the collector messages written to the journal: info adds one line per window, debug also traces the log stream. If omitted, the current value is kept (initially warning)
